empty.title: Start with the product
empty.text: Enter the purchase cost and quantity — the price list for every package, customer and month appears right away.

flex.label: Flexible price list
flex.tooltip: When the full discounts do not fit under the highest price — the maximum price from step 1 or a manually lowered base price — prices are spread proportionally between the minimum price (deepest discount) and that highest price (no discount). Discounts are then smaller than configured. When the discounts fit, nothing changes.

xlsx.priceListNote: Left table: net prices per unit, right: gross per unit. Package value = unit price × quantity — full amounts are in the "All combinations" sheet.
xlsx.discountsNote: Applied discount = 1 − price ÷ highest price (base price; in flexible mode the maximum price; in sale the sale base). It differs from the nominal one because of rounding, manual edits and the flexible mode.

calc.fixedExact: Fixed handling per unit (exact, before rounding)
calc.feeRate: Fee as a share of the net price (fee × (1 + VAT))
